title: (He plucks his lutestrings.) When first I saw.
html_source:
“When first I saw the lovelight in your eyes…”, from ‘When You were Sweet Sixteen’, written by James Thornton and published in 1898. The story of an estranged marriage echoes the relationship between Bloom and Molly.
